mechanism: Alendronate causes gastrointestinal irritation and esophageal ulceration risk, while tranylcypromine (MAOI) can exacerbate GI adverse effects and potentially increase bleeding risk through platelet effects.
action: Monitor for severe GI symptoms; ensure alendronate is taken with proper administration technique (upright position, adequate water); consider alternative osteoporosis therapy if GI intolerance develops.
